items.title: Amazon WorkSpaces for AI Agents Adds Linux, Windows 11, and OAuth Support
items.summary: In June, we announced the general availability of Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents. That launch gave your agents a managed way to operate the desktop applications your business runs on, including ERP clients, claims systems, engineering tools, and internal apps that were never built with an API.
